newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's Corp Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's Corp Q4 net rises.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Q4 1996 systemwide sales $8.28 billion vs $7.73 billion. Q4 1996 operating income $614.0 million vs $646.1 million. Q4 1996 results include $72 million special charge, or $48.7 million after tax.

Special charge relates to 1997 plans to strengthen U.S. business and reduce ongoing costs by closing about 115 low-volume U.S. satellite restaurants, replacing certain restaurant equipment, outsourcing excess property management, and implementing certain other cost efficiencies.
Q4 1996 provision for income tax $410.0 million after $50 million tax benefit vs $366.8 million.
Q4 1996 earnings per share after $6.9 million in preferred stock dividends vs $8.7 million a year ago.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Full-year 1996 systemwide sales $31.81 billion vs $29.91 billion.
1996 results after $16 million charge for SFAS 121 accounting change and $72 million pretax ($48.7 million after-tax) charge taken in Q4 for U.S. operations.
1996 earnings per share after $27.6 million in preferred stock dividends vs $40.5 million.

Full-year 1995 results also cut by $3.9 million for one-time effect of exchanging series E preferred stock for subordinated debt and by $400,000 for repurchase of additional series E preferred shares.
